subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should iMessage DM payloads whose sender canonically equals destination_caller_id be repaired only from canonical peer evidence and dropped fail-closed when recovery is not confident?
rationale: The repaired sender becomes the subject for allowlist, pairing, session routing, and replies, so accepting a weak identity source is a security and delivery-boundary decision rather than a routine style choice.

options.title: Require Canonical Repair And Fail Closed
options.body: Use normalizeIMessageHandle for every comparison, repair only when the recovered peer is canonically distinct, and drop or hold ambiguous payloads before access control.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Identity Risk
options.body: Merge the branch after minimal fixes while maintainers explicitly own the remaining formatted-handle and live-payload uncertainty.

options.title: Pause Until Root Cause Is Clear
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it if the author's remaining live failure proves to be a separate iMessage bug.

recommendation.title: Require Canonical Repair And Fail Closed
recommendation.body: Use normalizeIMessageHandle for every comparison, repair only when the recovered peer is canonically distinct, and drop or hold ambiguous payloads before access control.
